class.name: NetwInterestPerception
class.brief_description: What the local player is currently being shown of each entity, and what a layer's departure says to do about it.
class.description: Presentation is an edge rather than a state, and this book is what makes it one. An entity nothing has decided about yet is a third answer, distinct from decided-visible and decided-hidden, and [method set_visible] reports whether the answer moved. A caller that applied an effect on every pass instead would hide an already-hidden subtree and capture the suppressed values as if they were the live ones. HIDE does not end the resolution the way DESPAWN ends a leave's. A layer asking to hide and another asking for a callback are both honoured, because the built-in hide and a game's own reaction are not alternatives. [codeblock] set_visible(key, v) true when that is news resolve(layers, ...) {hide: bool, custom: [[Callable, layer]]} arm(key, custom) the actions standing in for the hide disarm(key) and the enter edge takes them back [/codeblock] Policies are the ordinals of [code]NetwMultiplayer.PerceptionPolicy[/code], which stays the one published spelling.

method.name: arm
method.description: Holds the CUSTOM actions that stood in for a hide, until [method disarm] takes them back. An empty [param actions] arms nothing, so an entity with no CUSTOM layer never appears in [method armed_keys].

method.name: armed_keys
method.description: Every entity holding armed actions. What a teardown owes an enter edge to, since nothing else will fire them.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every decision and every armed action. Session teardown.

method.name: disarm
method.description: Takes back and returns [param key]'s armed actions, leaving none. Draining is the point: the actions belong to one hide, and firing them twice would tell a game it became visible twice.

method.name: forget
method.description: Drops what was decided about [param key], so the next decision is news again. Leaves any armed actions alone, because a caller that means to drop those calls [method disarm].

method.name: is_known
method.description: Whether anything has been decided about [param key] yet.

method.name: resolve
method.description: What one loss of local visibility means, as [code]{hide: bool, custom: [[Callable, StringName]]}[/code]. [param decl] is the entity's own declaration and [param engine] supplies each layer's default through [method NetwInterestEngine.layer_perception_policy], so an override always resolves before a default and a layer nobody declared resolves to HIDE. A CUSTOM whose callback has since gone invalid hides instead and says so, because a subtree left visible with nothing standing in for the hide is the one outcome no layer asked for.

method.name: set_visible
method.description: Records what the local player is now shown of [param key], and answers whether that is news. An entity nothing has been decided about yet answers [code]true[/code] either way.
